notes.title: Scenario battles in campaigns are available
notes.content:
Hello Generals!

We’re thrilled to bring you the latest updates and improvements in our newest patch. Your feedback and support continue to drive us forward, and we’re committed to delivering the best gaming experience possible.

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Historical Battles Added
Dive into the rich history with newly added historical battles in both the US and British campaigns. (Work in Progress)[
[*] 
[*] Random Scenario Battles
Experience unpredictable challenges with random scenario battles now available in the US and British campaigns. (Work in Progress)
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved Relation System
Our revamped relation system offers a more nuanced interaction between factions, enhancing strategic depth.

[*] Artillery and Cavalry Condition Usage
Adjustments have been made to artillery and cavalry usage conditions. Natives and bonuses from high stats have been reduced to balance gameplay.

[*] Unit Retreat Mechanics
Individual units now have a higher likelihood to retreat fully when necessary, adding realism to battle outcomes.

[*] Melee Damage and Condition Tuning
Additional tweaks to melee damage and condition usage ensure more balanced and engaging combat.

[*] Merged Units Behavior
Fixed issues allowing merged units to surrender and retreat from battles. Surrender chances may require further adjustments when facing unmerged brigades.

[*] VP Control Impact
Victory Point (VP) control now significantly influences the balance bar and full retreat chances. AI retreat behavior is now influenced by VP control status, though this feature remains experimental and may need further tuning.

[*] Elevation and Movement Speed
Elevation changes now have a more noticeable effect on unit movement speed, adding tactical depth to terrain navigation.

[*] Regiment Name Customization
Increased the maximum length for editable regiment names, allowing for more personalized and descriptive titles.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Brigade Salary & Army Count
Fixed bugs related to brigade salaries and army count inaccuracies.

[*] Mercenaries' Salary
Corrected salary calculations for mercenaries to ensure fair compensation.

[*] Stuck Soldiers
Resolved issues causing soldiers to become stuck, ensuring smoother gameplay.

[*] Campaign Continuation Post-Victory
Fixed the issue where players were unable to continue the campaign after achieving victory.

[*] British Campaign Adjustments
King Payment Quest: Decreased the required amount for the king’s payment quest.
Army Salary & Ship Maintenance: In the first year, army salaries and ship maintenance costs will be partially compensated by the King.

[*] Surrender and Retreat Mechanics
Fixed multiple issues related to unit surrender and retreat mechanics during battles.

[*] Various Reported Issues
Addressed and fixed many of the bugs reported by our dedicated player community.
[/list]

[b]Performance & Audio Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Performance Improvements
Optimizations have been made to enhance overall game performance, reducing load times and improving stability.

[*] Sound Enhancements
Improved sound quality and fixed audio issues to provide a more immersive auditory experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We’re dedicated to making the game the best it can be and are excited for you to experience these new changes. Keep your strategies sharp and your armies ready!

Happy Gaming!
The UGAR Development Team

notes.title: Full British Campaign
notes.content:
We appreciate your support and trust. 

We are excited to announce that the full British campaign is now ready! We received many complaints about the game's difficulty, so we have rebalanced it. Additionally, we have added many new game elements to the difficulty levels, which should create a more enjoyable gameplay experience depending on the chosen difficulty. We’ve also overhauled the resource system and introduced new resources that can only be acquired in Europe.

In the US campaign, we’ve replaced the old tutorial battle of Concord with a prototype of a historical battle, allowing you to experience how scenario battles will be implemented in the game. 

Many players requested the option to continue playing after winning a campaign, so we’ve added a choice: you can decide whether to keep playing after victory or conclude the game. 

Along with these, there are many other new features and improvements.

We are currently working on localization for German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese. As part of improving battles, we are developing scenario-based battles, which will include both historical events and random skirmishes. Additionally, we plan to enhance the diplomacy system by adding more options, allowing you to use diplomacy more effectively in achieving your goals.

[b]New features:[/b]

[list]
[*]Full British Campaign
[*] New regional construction panel with additional tips and detailed information.
[*] New resources: tea, spice, cotton, sugar, and tobacco, which can be processed into higher-value goods like cigars, textiles, and rum.
[*] A rebellion mechanic in the British campaign: if colonies are overly dominated, a rebellion will occur. This option is only available in non-historical mode.
[*] Option to disable the port in the British campaign, preventing ships from using it.
[*] Gameplay Balancing and Enhancements.
[*]Rebalanced difficulty levels across all campaigns.
[*] Improved cavalry in tactical battles, with fixes for chasing retreating units.
[*] Added port mechanics: ports now serve a limited number of traders per day, with upgradeable infrastructure.
[*] Garrisons no longer provide full protection from rebellion; garrison size now scales with settlement population.
[*] Improved non-historical officers' names for better accuracy and consistency.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed soldiers getting stuck in obstacles.
[*] Fixed missing naval and land officers in British campaign projects.
[*] Corrected instant recovery of native villages.
[*] Fixed issues with multiple invasions on easy and normal difficulties.
[*] Fixed inability to unmark transfer orders.
[*] Huge amount of fixes of minor issues
[/list]

notes.title: British Campaign is Available
notes.content:
Hello Generals!

The first year of the British Campaign has been released in v0.4.25. 

We want to introduce the mechanics of the British Campaign and collect your feedback. More balancing and work are needed, but you can try it out and understand the basics of the British Campaign.

Moreover, we have done a huge amount of work to improve the game, mechanics, and balance. The most significant changes are listed below:

- European armies' transparency in homelands and dependency on invasions from available European troops. You can see how many troops can invade or support you. If there are no troops, then there is no invasion or support. The European nation can produce troops and a navy with speed depending on difficulty.
- Rework of native settlements and units. Now there won't be a never-ending spawn of natives and their settlements
- Decrement of navy maintenance.
- Improved particles
- Dynamic aggressiveness of AI. AI will be more active in the summer.
- Improved retreat in tactical battles
- Improved behavior of AI in tactical battles
- Rework of transports, now there will be trader, transport, and armed transport
- Rework of charge block, now there won't be any block, and your unit will move to start a melee with the enemy
- Improved hints and texts
- Added notification about missing British recruits in the colonies to refill your expeditionary regiments
- Improved global map minimap. Added settlements and visualization of potential rebellion
- Fixed issue when AI units did nothing when left tactical battle
- Tutorial quests and videos
- improved AI for cavalry in tactical battles
- Improved cavalry animations and behavior in tactical battles
- difficulty modifiers for merchants' travel time, the probability of being intercepted for merchants, European army and navy production
- Fleets are added to the intelligence report
- Navy map mode improved
- Supply map mode improved
- Huge amount of different fixes and improvements


Things we are currently working on:
- Full British campaign
- Historical battles integration
- Localization
- Improvements, bug fixes and balance

notes.title: Unstable branch access granted
notes.content:
Hello, Generals!

Thank you for your support and the long wait. In order for you to have access to the content that is in the works, we decided to create an unstable branch so that you can play new mechanics and content before they become publicly available. To do this, you need to enter the code [b]"unstablebranch"[/b] in Steam->Property->Betas. It will grant access to the branch, and you will be able to change the client.

Patch notes for the unstable branch will be posted in Discord: https://discord.gg/2JGsmSuGcU


P.S. Saves that will be created in the unstable version of the game are not compatible with the public version of the game.

At the moment, you can find the following things in the branch:

- The first year of the British campaign
- Dynamically aggressive AI on the global map
- Reworked settlement and spam of natives. Destroying villages does not lead to their immediate reappearance, the more villages are destroyed, the slower new ones appear. Native units are not full when they appear, and take time to fill.
- Improved General's behavior on the global map
- Reduced ship maintenance
- Reworked transports, now there will be a merchant, transport and armed transport
and many other improvements in different places of the game.

Currently, we are working on the following things:

- Integrated tutorials into quests
- Transparency of the British army and navy for the US campaign. You can see when Britain can send to invade colonies. If Britain doesn't have enough warships or regiments, then invasion won't happen
- Stabilization of the British campaign and further years for the campaign
- Improvements in AI
- Fixes of your reports and implementation of features required by you
